acquisition.empty.live: No acquisition tasks are in progress.
acquisition.empty.all: No acquisition tasks have been created yet.
acquisition.started: Acquisition task created. Track its progress in Active tasks.
acquisition.startFromUrl.label: Post or sharing-page URL
acquisition.startFromUrl.description: Enter a complete HTTP(S) page URL. This matches or creates a resource awaiting download and starts the workflow shown below.
acquisition.startFromUrl.steps.link: Paste a link to identify the resource you want.
acquisition.startFromUrl.steps.workflow: Choose an acquisition workflow or use the default.
acquisition.startFromUrl.steps.track: After creating the task, track it in Active tasks and respond when a step needs your input.
acquisition.startFromUrl.manualHelp: Automatic downloading depends on the workflow and source support. For cloud drives requiring login or verification, you usually need to download the files yourself and put them in the server's pending processing folder to continue.
acquisition.recipe.label: Workflow to run
acquisition.recipe.description: The configured default is selected when available. You can choose another workflow; the selected workflow runs when you create the task.
acquisition.retried: Running again from where it stopped.
acquisition.inbox.title: Pending processing folder
acquisition.inbox.hint: Assign manually downloaded files to waiting acquisition tasks.
acquisition.inbox.description: The pending processing folder is a temporary folder on the server, set in Download settings. Put manually downloaded files there so waiting tasks can continue. Downloads on other devices are not automatically transferred to the server.
acquisition.inbox.manualHelp: Once files have settled, Bakabase tries to match them to waiting tasks. Assign uncertain matches below. Claimed files are moved into the task's working folder.
acquisition.inbox.empty: The pending processing folder is empty.
acquisition.inbox.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting for a file right now.
acquisition.inbox.claimed: Files assigned to the task for processing.
acquisition.setup.title: Download settings
acquisition.setup.description: Configure the pending processing folder, library folder, and download link preferences.
acquisition.setup.done: Ready. Point your browser's downloads at the pending processing folder and you are set.
acquisition.setup.inbox.label: Pending processing folder
acquisition.setup.inbox.description: Enter a folder accessible to the machine running the server. Copy files downloaded on other devices here first. For containers, use the mounted path inside the container.
acquisition.setup.inbox.explanation: The pending processing folder is the handoff folder between manual downloads and automated organization. When an acquisition task is waiting for files, put the completed download here so the matching task can continue processing it.
acquisition.setup.inbox.example: For example, download Star Voyage.zip on your laptop, transfer it to the server's pending processing folder, then let the matching task unpack and organize it into the library folder. If the match is unclear, assign it to a task in Pending processing folder.
acquisition.setup.inbox.help: How does the pending processing folder work?
acquisition.setup.library.label: Library folder
acquisition.setup.library.description: Choose where resources are saved on the server, including a subfolder of an existing folder.
acquisition.setup.library.mark: Files are placed here using your path template, then the final folder is associated with the resource.
acquisition.setup.template.label: Relative resource path
acquisition.setup.template.description: A path inside the library folder. Separate levels with /. Use {Title}, {LeadKind}, {Date}, {ResourceId}, or variables supplied by the workflow.
acquisition.setup.drives.label: Preferences for choosing between download links
acquisition.setup.drives.description: When shared content yields multiple download links, this order determines the default choice. It has no effect when there is only one link.
acquisition.setup.drives.scope: This setting does not search cloud drives by resource name or configure download tools.
acquisition.setup.drives.hint: Click to select; lower numbers come first. Click again to remove; reselect to move to the end. Unselected sources remain available, and you can skip this setting.
acquisition.setup.limit.label: Buy without asking up to
acquisition.setup.limit.description: Zero never buys unattended; anything dearer stops and shows the price.
acquisition.sharedList.title: Import resource list
acquisition.sharedList.hint: Add resources from a text file or spreadsheet, with a preview before import.
acquisition.sharedList.description: Download the recommended CSV template and use one row per resource. TXT, TSV, XLSX, and XLS are also supported (only the first Excel worksheet is read). Review and edit the preview before confirming. Importing adds resource information without creating download tasks by default.
acquisition.sharedList.example: Your supplied link determines where to get the resource. A name alone can be imported as an item to acquire, but will not trigger a name search or automatic acquisition. Archive passwords are optional; keep cloud-drive access codes in the shared link.
acquisition.sharedList.templateHelp: Open the template in Excel, keep the headers, replace or delete both example rows, and save as CSV UTF-8. The example URL is not a real download link. Enter at least a name or a link; enter archive passwords exactly as written, without a “password:” prefix.
acquisition.sharedList.readFailed: The file could not be read. Check its format and choose it again. Existing resources are unchanged.
acquisition.sharedList.nothingRead: Nothing in that file looked like a list.
acquisition.sharedList.column.title: Title
acquisition.sharedList.startAcquiring: Also create acquisition tasks for items with links
acquisition.matches.empty: Nothing looks like a duplicate of anything you already have.
acquisition.matches.description: These pairs are named alike enough to be worth a look. Nothing is merged until you say so — the one on the left goes away, and what it brought with it (where to get it, which collections wanted it) becomes the one on the right's.
acquisition.recipes.title: Configured workflows
acquisition.recipes.createDescription: Start with a shared-download template and configure the steps for parsing, receiving files, and adding them to your library.
acquisition.overview.description: Browse resources not yet downloaded and choose an acquisition workflow. Link availability is confirmed when the workflow runs.
acquisition.overview.unverifiedDescripti: These are known leads and supported acquisition methods. Link availability, account access, and required configuration are checked during execution. A listed source does not confirm ownership or guarantee acquisition.
acquisition.overview.unsupportedPlatform: This build does not implement acquisition from this platform.
acquisition.overview.noApplicableRecipe: No acquisition workflow applies to this source.
acquisition.overview.defaultUnavailable: The default workflow is missing or incompatible with this source. Choose another workflow for this acquisition.
acquisition.overview.selectRecipeFirst: Choose a workflow to review its steps and create a task.
acquisition.overview.loadFailed: Could not load the resource list. Please try again.
acquisition.overview.empty: No resources to download match these conditions.
acquisition.overview.noSourcesDescriptio: Add an existing link in resource details, or collect sources through subscriptions and shared-list imports. Resource names are not automatically searched for download links.
acquisition.recipes.description: Review workflow descriptions, node order and configuration checks. Input compatibility is declared by the workflow; checks do not verify links or search for downloads by name.
acquisition.recipes.empty: No acquisition workflows are configured. Use New workflow to create one.
acquisition.setup.template.invalid: Enter a relative path without a leading slash or drive letter. Empty levels and the segments "." and ".." are not allowed.
acquisition.setup.template.example: For example, Games/{Date}/{Title} groups resources by date and gives each resource its own folder. Missing folders are created during placement; workflow variables use the actual task values.
acquisition.startFromUrl.title: Create a task from a shared page
acquisition.startFromUrl.scopeDescriptio: Enter a post or sharing page whose content includes download links or access codes, such as an article introducing a work and linking to its files.
acquisition.startFromUrl.preflightLimit: The form checks the address format only. Creating a task may read the page title, but does not verify download availability. Content parsing and downloading happen in the workflow; login, CAPTCHA, or dynamically loaded pages may prevent parsing.
acquisition.startFromUrl.defaultLoadFail: Could not load the default workflow. Retry or explicitly choose a workflow for this task.
acquisition.startFromUrl.defaultMissing: The configured default workflow is unavailable. Choose a workflow for this task.
acquisition.startFromUrl.noCompatibleRec: No workflow can process a sharing page and add it to the library. Configure one using New workflow first.
acquisition.startFromUrl.otherLinks: How do I use file links, magnets, cloud drives or platform links?
acquisition.startFromUrl.directAndMagnet: For a direct file URL, magnet or torrent, add the matching source type to the pending resource. Torrents accept an HTTP(S) URL or a .torrent upload. This sharing-page entry does not automatically convert source types.
acquisition.startFromUrl.cloudAndPlatfor: Cloud-drive pages usually require you to download through the drive and place the completed files in the server’s pending processing folder. Platform acquisition uses synced resource identities from supported platforms such as Steam, DLsite or ExHentai, rather than a product-page URL entered here.
acquisition.startFromUrl.completeForm: Enter a sharing-page URL and select an available workflow.
acquisition.startFromUrl.failed: Could not create the acquisition task. Please retry.
acquisition.workflow.sharedContent.descr: Uses the configured AI to extract links and passwords from shared pages or text, selects a link, then waits for you to provide downloaded files in the pending processing folder before extracting and importing them.
acquisition.workflow.directDownload.desc: Downloads an HTTP(S) file on the server, extracts archives when needed, then organizes and associates the files with the resource.
acquisition.workflow.manualMagnet.descri: Download the magnet with your own client, then provide the completed files in the pending processing folder for import.
acquisition.workflow.magnetDownload.desc: Downloads a magnet on the server using the built-in BitTorrent engine and imports its files with the folder structure preserved. Does not extract archives by default; stops seeding when complete.
acquisition.workflow.torrentDownload.des: Uses an uploaded .torrent file or HTTP(S) torrent URL to download on the server with the built-in BitTorrent engine, preserving the folder structure on import. Does not extract archives by default; stops seeding when complete.
acquisition.workflow.platform.descriptio: Obtains or installs the resource through its linked platform account and associates the platform’s directory, leaving files in their original location.
acquisition.workflow.localDirectory.desc: Selects an existing server folder, organizes it using the library settings and associates it with the resource.
acquisition.input.label: Compatible inputs
